title: "ENTICES runs"
output: html_notebook

> **Sandbox notebook: run it chunk by chunk, not with Knit or Run All.** It
> holds example and exploratory calls of the generators (`generate_phreeqc_input_*`)
> and restarts, kept as Lucas's working record. It isn't a test or a
> reproducible pipeline: chunks depend on one another's state and on local file
> paths, and several chunks `source()` scripts that **are not in this repo**:
> `minerals_plot.R`, `chemistry_plot.R`, `sweep_heatmaps.R`,
> `porewater_kinetic_plots.R`, `sweep_plots.R`, `ph_fp_wr_plot.R`,
> `stacked_rxn_progress_plots.R`, `bulk_comparison_plots.R`,
> `bulk_kinetic_comparison.R`, `step_comparison.R`, `stitch_plots.R`,
> `check1_regression.R`, `check2_grouping.R`, `check3_conservation.R` and
> `water_rock_calculator.R`. Those chunks fail without them.
> (`mineral_dissolution_constants.R` with a capital R resolves to
> `mineral_dissolution_constants.r` only on case-insensitive file systems.)
> For the supported entry points and self-tests, see `README.md`.

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
# Create Enceladus configuration
source("ENTICES_LF_20260917.R")

enceladus <- EnceladusConfig$new()

props <- enceladus$get_derived_properties()

# Print initial configuration details
print("Initial configuration properties:")
print(props)

# Plot gravity profile
enceladus$plot_gravity_profile()
seafloor_g <- enceladus$calculate_gravity(enceladus$core_radius)
print(paste("Gravity at seafloor:", seafloor_g, "m/s^2"))

# Create and run hydrothermal simulator
sim <- Simulator$new(
  k = 1e-12,              # Permeability [m²]
  layer_thickness = 600,   # Layer thickness [m]
  porosity = 0.32,        # Porosity [dimensionless]
  config = enceladus      # Use our Enceladus configuration
)

# Run simulation
results <- sim$run_simulation(timesteps = 1000)
print("Simulation results summary:")
print(sim$get_summary_metrics())

# Generate simulation plots
plots <- sim$generate_plots()
print("Simulation plots:")
print(plots)
```


```{r}
# === User parameters ===
# mode = "ocean_circulations" : adaptive time steps. Many orbital cycles are bundled
#                               using the auto-computed grouping factor.
#                               Set n_circulations = number of full ocean circulations.
#
# mode = "ungrouped"          : high-resolution. Each KINETICS step = 1 orbital period.
#                               Set n_orbital_cycles = number of orbital cycles.
#
# mode = "grouped"            : user-controlled grouping. Same n_orbital_cycles as
#                               "ungrouped" but steps cover grouping_factor orbital periods.
#                               Useful for directly comparing grouped vs ungrouped output
#                               over the same total time span.
#                               Set n_orbital_cycles and grouping_factor.

cycle_mode       <- "ungrouped"  # "ocean_circulations", "ungrouped", or "grouped"
n_circulations   <- NULL         # used when mode = "ocean_circulations"
n_orbital_cycles <- 10000         # used when mode = "ungrouped" or "grouped"
grouping_factor  <- NULL         # used when mode = "grouped"  e.g. grouping_factor <- 10

# Initialize PHREEQC integration
phreeqc <- PhreeqcIntegrator$new(sim)

# Generate PHREEQC input file
phreeqc_file <- phreeqc$generate_phreeqc_input_equil(
  n_orbital_cycles = n_orbital_cycles
)
print(paste("PHREEQC input file generated:", phreeqc_file))

# Print PHREEQC parameters
print("PHREEQC scaling parameters:")
print(phreeqc$phreeqc_params)
```

```{r}
  k = k_values,

)
```

```{r}
# Summarize sweep results
print("\nParameter sweep summary:")
sweep_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sweep_results, function(x) {
  data.frame(
    k = x$params$k,
    layer_thickness = x$params$layer_thickness,
    mean_flow_rate = x$metrics$mean_flow_rate_Ls,
    circulation_time = x$metrics$circulation_time_years,
    complete_circulation_time = x$metrics$complete_circulation_time
  )
}))
print(sweep_summary)
```
```{r}
# Create summary plot
sweep_plot <- ggplot(sweep_summary,
                    aes(x = log10(k), y = layer_thickness,
                        size = mean_flow_rate, color = circulation_time)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "log10(Permeability [m²])",
       y = "Layer Thickness [m]",
       size = "Mean Flow Rate [L/s]",
       color = "Circulation Time [years]") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.8)
ggsave("sweep_summary_plot.png", plot = sweep_plot, dpi = 300, width = 7, height = 4)

sweep_plot2 <- ggplot(sweep_summary,
                     aes(x = log10(k), y = layer_thickness,
                         size = mean_flow_rate, color = complete_circulation_time)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "log10(Permeability [m²])",
       y = "Layer Thickness [m]",
       size = "Mean Flow Rate [L/s]",
       color = "Complete Circ. Time [years]") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.8)
ggsave("sweep_summary_plot2.png", plot = sweep_plot2, dpi = 300, width = 7, height = 4)
```

```{r}
# STEP 1: Create Enceladus configuration

# Step 2: Create the hydrothermal simulator

  k = 1e-11,              # Permeability [m²] 
  layer_thickness = 194.2e3,  # Permeable layer thickness [m]
  porosity = 0.32,        # Porosity [fraction]
  config = config         # Enceladus configuration
)

# Step 3: Run the simulation
results <- sim$run_simulation(timesteps = 1000)

# Step 4: Create PhreeqcIntegrator
phreeqc <- PhreeqcIntegrator$new(sim)

# Step 5: Calculate PHREEQC parameters with organic content
phreeqc$calculate_phreeqc_parameters(organic_wt_percent = 15)

# === User parameters ===
# mode = "ocean_circulations" : adaptive time steps. Many orbital cycles are bundled
#                               using the auto-computed grouping factor.
#                               Set n_circulations = number of full ocean circulations.
#
# mode = "ungrouped"          : high-resolution. Each KINETICS step = 1 orbital period.
#                               Set n_orbital_cycles = number of orbital cycles.
#
# mode = "grouped"            : user-controlled grouping. Same n_orbital_cycles as
#                               "ungrouped" but steps cover grouping_factor orbital periods.
#                               Set n_orbital_cycles and grouping_factor.

cycle_mode       <- "ocean_circulations"  # "ocean_circulations", "ungrouped", or "grouped"
n_circulations   <- 5                     # used when mode = "ocean_circulations"
n_orbital_cycles <- NULL                  # used when mode = "ungrouped" or "grouped"
grouping_factor  <- NULL                  # used when mode = "grouped"  e.g. grouping_factor <- 10
```

```{r}
# Thicknesses to sweep (metres)
thickness_values <- c(500, 1e3, 5e3, 1e4, 194.2e3)

bulk_files <- list()

for (d in thickness_values) {
  config_bulk <- EnceladusConfig$new()
  sim_bulk    <- Simulator$new(
    k               = 1e-12,      # arbitrary — not used in this file type
    layer_thickness = d,
    porosity        = 0.32,
    config          = config_bulk
  )
  sim_bulk$run_simulation(timesteps = 1000)

  phreeqc_bulk <- PhreeqcIntegrator$new(sim_bulk)
  fname        <- phreeqc_bulk$generate_phreeqc_input_hydrosphere_equil()
  bulk_files[[as.character(d)]] <- fname
  print(paste("Written:", fname))
}
```

```{r}
library(tibble)

TC <- 1.45; TK <- TC + 273.15
grouping_factor <- 4; substeps <- 1; H <- 1e-7
minerals <- c("Forsterite","Enstatite","Troilite",
              "Albite","Diopside","Anorthite","K-Feldspar","Tephroite",
              "IOM_CO2","IOM_CH4","IOM_N", "IOM_S")
moles <- c(2.8833, 0.2212, 2.9845, 0.6569, 0.7981, 0.2323, 0.0616, 0.0527,
            0.62535, 0.28620, 0.13125, 0.06930)
diss_per_step <- mapply(dissolution_per_step, minerals, moles,
                        MoreArgs= list(grouping_factor/substeps, H=H, TK=TK, fe3=1e-30))
frac_per_step <- diss_per_step/moles
frac_per_step
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)

```

```{r}
# === Load PHREEQC output and drop all-zero columns ===
phreeqc_output_file <- "/Users/fiferelsi/Documents/phreeqc-3.5.0-14000/enceladus_k1.00e-07_d500_orb10000_equil.csv"

raw_data <- read.delim(phreeqc_output_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, strip.white = TRUE)

zero_cols   <- names(raw_data)[sapply(raw_data, function(col) all(col == 0))]
active_data <- raw_data[, !names(raw_data) %in% zero_cols]

cat("Dropped", length(zero_cols), "all-zero columns:\n")
print(zero_cols)
cat("\nRemaining columns:", ncol(active_data), "\n")

active_minerals <- c("Analcime", "Beidellite.Na","Boehmite","Brucite","Cronstedtite.7A",
                      "Greenalite","Saponite.Fe.Fe","Saponite.Fe.Na","Saponite.Mg.Ca",
                      "Saponite.Mg.Mg","Saponite.Mg.Na","Tobermorite.11A")
active_minerals <- active_minerals[!active_minerals %in% zero_cols]

```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
# === Plot remaining primary mineral masses (reacted porewater only) ===
remain_cols <- names(active_data)[grepl("remain_g", names(active_data))]

remain_data <- active_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(step != -99) %>%
  group_by(Time_Years) %>%
  mutate(solution_type = factor(
    row_number(),
    levels = 1:4,
    labels = c("Reacted porewater", "Combined ocean", "Resampled porewater", "Updated ocean")
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(solution_type == "Reacted porewater") %>%
  select(Time_Years, all_of(remain_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(remain_cols), names_to = "mineral", values_to = "mass_g") %>%
  mutate(mineral = gsub("_remain_g", "", mineral))  # strip suffix for cleaner labels

p_remain <- ggplot(remain_data, aes(x = Time_Years, y = mass_g, color = mineral)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Mineral") +
  labs(
    x     = "Time (years)",
    y     = "Remaining mass (g)",
    title = "Primary mineral depletion — reacted porewater"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio    = 0.55,
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

phreeqc_base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(phreeqc_output_file))
ggsave(paste0(phreeqc_base, "_remain_plot.png"), plot = p_remain, dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 4.4)
```

```{r}
# === Plot pH vs time from PHREEQC output ===
# Each time step produces 4 output rows (classified by water mass rank):
#   Reacted porewater   - smallest mass (water consumed by hydration reactions)
#   Resampled porewater - second smallest (taken from combined fluid)
#   Ocean               - second largest  (updated ocean)
#   Combined fluid      - largest (pore + ocean before resampling)

#phreeqc_output_file <- "/Users/fiferelsi/Documents/phreeqc-3.5.0-14000/enceladus_k1.00e-12_d600_orb2000.csv"

ph_raw <- read.delim(phreeqc_output_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, strip.white = TRUE)
ph_raw <- ph_raw[ph_raw$step != -99, ]

ph_data <- ph_raw %>%
  group_by(Time_Years) %>%
  mutate(solution_type = factor(
    row_number(),
    levels = 1:4,
    labels = c("Reacted porewater", "Combined ocean", "Resampled porewater", "Updated ocean")
  )) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
metrics <- sim$get_summary_metrics()
orbital_period_years <- sim$config$orbital_period / (365.25 * 24 * 3600)
circ_time <- metrics$circulation_time_years
n_orb <- circ_time / orbital_period_years
cat("old:", circ_time * log(circ_time) + 0.577 * circ_time, "\n")
cat("new:", (n_orb * log(n_orb) + 0.577 * n_orb) * orbital_period_years, "\n")
```

```{r}
# === Test chunk: layer-normalised run (k=1e-10, d=500 m) ===
# Uses suffix="_layernorm" so output files are named e.g.
#   enceladus_k1.00e-10_d500_orb100_layernorm.pqi / .csv
# and won't overwrite existing runs.

config_test <- EnceladusConfig$new()
sim_test <- Simulator$new(
  k               = 1e-10,
  layer_thickness = 500,
  porosity        = 0.32,
  config          = config_test
)
results_test <- sim_test$run_simulation(timesteps = 1000)

phreeqc_test <- PhreeqcIntegrator$new(sim_test)
phreeqc_test$calculate_phreeqc_parameters()

print("PHREEQC params for test run:")
print(phreeqc_test$phreeqc_params)

test_file <- phreeqc_test$generate_phreeqc_input(
  mode             = "ungrouped",
  n_orbital_cycles = 1000,
  suffix           = "_layernorm"
)
print(paste("Test input written to:", test_file))
```

```{r}
source("ENTICES_LF_20260917.R")

wr_ratios <- c(.1574)#.2, .3, .45, .6)

for (wr in wr_ratios) {
  config_bulk <- EnceladusConfig$new()
  sim_bulk    <- Simulator$new(
    k               = 1e-12,
    layer_thickness = 1000,
    porosity        = 0.32,
    config          = config_bulk
  )

  sim_bulk$run_simulation(timesteps = 1000)

  phreeqc_bulk <- PhreeqcIntegrator$new(sim_bulk)

  phreeqc_bulk$generate_phreeqc_input_bulk_kinetic(
    mode="porewater",
    n_orbital_cycles=3,
    water_rock_ratio= wr,
    suffix="SMALLWATER_test_v2_receqbFALSE", 
    rec_eqb_minerals = FALSE,
    CH4_redox_override="coupled",
    porewater_temp=160

  )
}



 
```
